molecule_id.description: Stable unique identity — never changes, even if content changes

canonicalHash.description: SHA-256 hash of content payload — content identity, not molecule identity

molecule_type.description: Constitutional molecule type determining challenge surface and governance tier

weight_class.description: Whether this molecule is governed by constitutional or operational rules

is_foundational.description: Foundational molecules propagate NOTED challenge pressure indefinitely regardless of depth

kCv_v_quality.description: Verification quality — WEAK (approved, no challenge) or STRONG (survived challenge)

kCv_rank.description: kCvRank — lineage authority score computed from survival history of ancestors

capture_confidence.description: Estimated completeness of evidence capture — not a score, a provenance quality indicator

evidence_gap_flag.description: True if molecule has high utility but sparse observation evidence — C-12 protection applies

observation_density.description: Observations per unit time, normalised — signals whether evidence capture is active

reuse_count.description: Number of distinct citing molecules — tracked for C-6 mandatory review threshold

active_challenge_id.description: Challenge ID if molecule is currently COLLAPSING or UNDER_GOVERNANCE

propagation_status.description: Current lineage pressure propagation status inherited from ancestors

propagation_depth.description: Depth from the challenged ancestor producing current propagation status

propagation_source_molecule_id.description: molecule_id of the ancestor whose challenge is propagating to this molecule

damping_factor.description: Domain-level damping factor (0.4-0.8, default 0.6 per Constitution v1.0)

parent_molecule_ids.description: Direct lineage parents — molecule_ids this molecule depends on

lineage_types.description: Parallel array to parent_molecule_ids — relationship type for each parent

lineage_certainty.description: Certainty of lineage reconstruction — C-14 applies to INFERRED and UNKNOWN

successor_molecule_id.description: If SUPERSEDED, the molecule_id that supersedes this one

scope_definition.description: If CONTEXTUAL, the explicit boundary within which this molecule is valid

constitution_version.description: Constitution version under which this molecule was created — v1.0

author_domain_id.description: The domain that created and is authoritative for this molecule

embedding_model_id.description: Which embedding model produced the vector for this molecule

embedding_timestamp.description: When this molecule was embedded into the vector store

last_fact_id.description: fact_id of the most recent JournalFact affecting this molecule

last_observation_id.description: observation_id of the most recent JournalObservation for this molecule

state_since.description: ISO timestamp when molecule entered its current state

mandatory_review_due.description: ISO timestamp when C-6 mandatory review becomes constitutionally required
